from solution import next_smallest_palindrome


def _is_palindrome(value):
    return str(value) == str(value)[::-1]


def test_issue_example_99():
    """Example asserts next_smallest_palindrome(99) is 101."""
    assert next_smallest_palindrome(99) == 101  # 99 + 2 = 101


def test_issue_zero():
    """Find the next smallest palindrome after 0."""
    assert next_smallest_palindrome(0) == 1  # 0 + 1 = 1


def test_issue_single_digit():
    """Find the next smallest palindrome of a single digit."""
    assert next_smallest_palindrome(7) == 8  # 7 + 1 = 8


def test_issue_nine_to_eleven():
    """Find the next smallest palindrome after single-digit 9."""
    assert next_smallest_palindrome(9) == 11  # 9 + 2 = 11


def test_issue_ten_to_eleven():
    """Find the next smallest palindrome after 10."""
    assert next_smallest_palindrome(10) == 11  # 10 + 1 = 11


def test_issue_hundred():
    """Find the next smallest palindrome after 100."""
    assert next_smallest_palindrome(100) == 101  # 100 + 1 = 101


def test_issue_three_digit_increment():
    """Find the next smallest palindrome after 123."""
    assert next_smallest_palindrome(123) == 131  # 123 + 8 = 131


def test_issue_input_already_palindrome():
    """Next palindrome is strictly greater even when input is a palindrome."""
    assert next_smallest_palindrome(121) == 131  # 121 + 10 = 131


def test_issue_even_length():
    """Find the next smallest palindrome after even-length 1234."""
    assert next_smallest_palindrome(1234) == 1331  # 1234 + 97 = 1331


def test_issue_carry_with_nines():
    """Find the next smallest palindrome after 199 with middle carry."""
    assert next_smallest_palindrome(199) == 202  # 199 + 3 = 202


def test_issue_all_nines_expand():
    """Find the next smallest palindrome after 999 expands length."""
    assert next_smallest_palindrome(999) == 1001  # 999 + 2 = 1001


def test_contract_result_is_palindrome():
    """Result must read the same forwards and backwards."""
    result = next_smallest_palindrome(129)
    assert result == 131  # 129 + 2 = 131
    assert _is_palindrome(result)


def test_contract_result_is_next_smallest():
    """Result must be the smallest palindrome greater than the input."""
    num = 1220
    result = next_smallest_palindrome(num)
    assert result == 1221  # 1220 + 1 = 1221
    assert result > num
    assert _is_palindrome(result)
    assert all(not _is_palindrome(i) for i in range(num + 1, result))
